titleTh: ซื้อผลไม้ที่ตลาด
scenarioSentences: You are at the morning market.
You want to buy some fruit.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good morning, Mr. Tran. How much are the mangoes?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Tran
dialogue.text: They're one dollar each. They're very sweet this week.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Are they ripe? I want to eat them today.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Tran
dialogue.text: These yellow ones are ripe. The green ones need three more days.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'd like the yellow ones, please.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Tran
dialogue.text: How many do you want?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Four, please. They're for my family.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Tran
dialogue.text: Sure. That's four dollars. Do you need a bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, thanks. I have my own bag.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Tran
dialogue.text: Here you are. Enjoy your mangoes!

titleEn: Inviting a friend to a movie
titleTh: ชวนเพื่อนไปดูหนัง
scenarioSentences: A new movie is out this week.
You really want to see it.
You don't want to go alone.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Anna. Do you want to see a movie on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Sure! Which movie?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The new one about the space trip. People say it's good.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh, I want to see that too. When is it on?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: There are shows at two and at seven on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I work on Saturday afternoon. Can we go in the evening?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, the seven o'clock show is fine.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Great. Where can we meet?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Let's meet at the cinema at six thirty.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll buy the popcorn!

titleTh: ทำบัตรห้องสมุด
scenarioSentences: You go to the city library.
Mrs. Moore works at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Mrs. Moore. I'd like to get a library card.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Moore
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you live in this city?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. I moved here last month.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Moore
dialogue.text: Good. Can I see your ID, please?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here it is. How much does the card cost?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Moore
dialogue.text: Nothing. It's free for everyone in the city.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great! How many books can I borrow?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Moore
dialogue.text: Five books for two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I take some books home today?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Moore
dialogue.text: Yes. Here's your card. You can use it now.

titleTh: สั่งอาหารกลางวันที่โรงอาหาร
scenarioSentences: It is lunch time at school.
Joe works at the food counter.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Joe. What's good today?

dialogue.speaker: Joe
dialogue.text: We have chicken rice and beef noodles.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Which one is spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Joe
dialogue.text: The noodles are a little spicy. The chicken rice isn't.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I don't like spicy food. I'll have the chicken rice, please.

dialogue.speaker: Joe
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you want a drink with it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What drinks do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Joe
dialogue.text: Orange juice, iced tea, and water. Water is free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then I'll have water, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Joe
dialogue.text: Four dollars. Here's your lunch.

titleEn: Locked out of the dorm room
titleTh: ลืมกุญแจไว้ในห้องหอ
scenarioSentences: Your keys are inside your room.
Mr. Kim is the security guard.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, Mr. Kim. I'm locked out of my room.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Kim
dialogue.text: Oh dear. Where are your keys?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: They're inside. I left them on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Kim
dialogue.text: Which room is yours?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Room 412, on the fourth floor.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Kim
dialogue.text: I can open it. But first, can I see your student card?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here it is. My name is on it.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Kim
dialogue.text: Thank you. Yes, you live in 412. Let's go up.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks so much. Sorry about this.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Kim
dialogue.text: It's okay. Next time, please keep your keys with you.

titleEn: Booking a taxi to the airport
titleTh: จองแท็กซี่ไปสนามบิน
scenarioSentences: You have an early flight tomorrow.
There are no buses that early.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Rosa. I need a taxi to the airport tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: Rosa
dialogue.text: Sure. What time is your flight?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's at seven. What time do I need to leave?

dialogue.speaker: Rosa
dialogue.text: It takes forty minutes. A five o'clock taxi is best.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, five a.m. then. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Rosa
dialogue.text: It's thirty dollars. You pay the driver.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: Rosa
dialogue.text: Yes, you can. What's your address?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Twelve Green Street, apartment three.

dialogue.speaker: Rosa
dialogue.text: Thank you. The taxi will be there at five.

titleTh: เลือกของขวัญวันเกิดให้แม่
scenarioSentences: Your mom's birthday is next week.
You want to buy her a gift.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Ella. Mom's birthday is next week. What can we buy her?

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.text: Good question. What about a book?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: She has so many books. I want something different.

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.text: Okay. She often feels cold in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh! What about a warm scarf?

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.text: That's a great idea. Her favorite color is red.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Let's buy a red scarf together. We can share the cost.

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.text: Sure. Let's go to the mall on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Let's meet there at two.

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.text: Okay. See you then!

titleTh: สมัครเรียนเทนนิสสำหรับมือใหม่
scenarioSentences: The sports center has a class.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Coach Miller. I'd like to join the tennis class.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Miller
dialogue.text: Great! Can you play already?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I'm a beginner. Is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Miller
dialogue.text: Of course. The beginner class is on Monday or Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm busy on Mondays. Wednesday is good.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Miller
dialogue.text: Okay. It starts at four and ends at five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What do I need? I don't have a racket.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Miller
dialogue.text: That's fine. You can borrow one from us for free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks! Do I need special shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Miller
dialogue.text: Just sports shoes and water. See you Wednesday!

titleTh: เปลี่ยนแผนเพราะฝนตก
scenarioSentences: You planned a beach trip today.
Your friend Max is coming too.
The beach is no fun now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Max. Did you see the rain?

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: Yes. We can't go to the beach now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No. What can we do today?

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: How about the city museum? It's inside, so we won't get wet.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good idea. There's a new show about dinosaurs.

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: Great. Let's go at ten. Then we can have lunch.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where can we eat?

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: There's a nice noodle shop next to the museum.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Meet you at the bus stop at nine thirty.

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: Okay. Don't forget your umbrella!

titleTh: ตัดแว่นตาใหม่
scenarioSentences: You sit at the back in class.
You cannot see the board well.
You go to a glasses shop.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Ms. Shah. I can't see the board in class.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Shah
dialogue.text: I see. Can you read books well?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Books are fine. Things far away aren't clear.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Shah
dialogue.text: Let's do an eye test. Read the letters on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. E, F, P... the small ones are hard.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Shah
dialogue.text: You need glasses for seeing far away.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I like these black ones. When will they be ready?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Shah
dialogue.text: Next Tuesday. They are eighty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's fine. I'll pick them up then.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Shah
dialogue.text: Good. I'll call you when they arrive.

titleEn: Getting ready for a family visit
titleTh: เตรียมห้องรอพ่อแม่มาเยี่ยม
scenarioSentences: They want to see your home.
Your place is not very clean.
You talk to her after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ruby, my parents are coming tomorrow at noon.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.text: Oh! Our place isn't ready.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I know. Can you help me clean tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.text: Of course. What do we need to do?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Wash the floor, clean the windows, and put our clothes away.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.text: I can do the floor and the windows.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks! Then I'll put away the clothes.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.text: Do we need anything from the shop?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, some fruit for my parents. I'll get it in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.text: Okay. Let's start at eight tonight.

titleTh: ชวนเพื่อนมาดูฟุตบอลด้วยกัน
scenarioSentences: There is a big soccer game tonight.
Your friend Dan likes soccer too.
You don't want to watch alone.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hey, Dan. Do you want to watch the game tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.text: Yes! Where can we watch it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: In my room. I have a big TV.

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.text: Great. When does the game begin?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: At nine. Come at half past eight.

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.text: Can I bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Can you bring some snacks?

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll bring chips and some drinks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll order a pizza for us.

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.text: Sounds great. See you at half past eight!

titleTh: ซื้อกระเป๋าเป้ใบใหม่
scenarioSentences: You need a new one for school.
You go to a bag shop.
You tell her what you need.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Grace. I need a backpack for school.

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.text: Sure. Big or small?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A big one. I carry a laptop and many books.

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.text: Those two bags are big. Which color do you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I like the green one. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.text: It's fifty dollars. But the black one is on sale for thirty.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is the black one big too?

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.text: Yes, and it's very strong.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then I'll buy the black one, please.

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.text: Good choice. You can pay here.

titleTh: ทำแพนเค้กเป็นอาหารเช้า
scenarioSentences: You and Lucas share an apartment.
You both want pancakes for breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Lucas, let's make pancakes for breakfast!

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: Good idea. What do we need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Flour, eggs, milk, and a little sugar.

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: We have flour and sugar. Let me check the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Are there any eggs?

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: No, and there's only a little milk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then we need to buy eggs and milk first.

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: The small shop on the corner opens at eight.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll go now. Can you get the pan ready?

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll start when you come back.

titleEn: Using the Wi-Fi at a café
titleTh: ต่อไวไฟที่ร้านกาแฟ
scenarioSentences: You need the internet for homework.
You don't know the Wi-Fi password.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, Zara. What's the Wi-Fi password?

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: It's on your receipt, at the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh, I see it. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Is it working?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's very slow. I can't open my homework.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Sorry about that. The Wi-Fi is not good at the back.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where is it better?

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Near the counter. There's a free table by the window there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll move my things there now.

dialogue.speaker: Zara
dialogue.text: Good. And your coffee is coming soon.

titleTh: ซ่อมยางจักรยานแบน
scenarioSentences: You ride your bike to school.
Today, your back tire is flat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Felix, my bike tire is flat. Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: Felix
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you have a pump?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't. That's the problem.

dialogue.speaker: Felix
dialogue.text: I have one in my room. Does the tire have a hole?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I don't know. I rode on it a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Felix
dialogue.text: Then it probably has one. I can fix that too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great! When are you free?

dialogue.speaker: Felix
dialogue.text: After class, at three. Bring the bike to my dorm.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll walk it there at three.

dialogue.speaker: Felix
dialogue.text: Good. It will take about twenty minutes.

titleEn: Visiting the dentist for a toothache
titleTh: ไปหาหมอฟันเพราะปวดฟัน
scenarioSentences: It hurts when you eat cold food.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Dr. Moreno, my tooth hurts. Is it bad?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Moreno
dialogue.text: When does it hurt?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: When I eat ice cream or drink cold water.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Moreno
dialogue.text: I see. There's a small hole in your back tooth.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh no. What do we need to do?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Moreno
dialogue.text: You need a small filling. It's easy and quick.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Does it hurt?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Moreno
dialogue.text: No. We give you medicine first, so you won't feel it.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can we do it today?

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Moreno
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'm busy today. Come back next Monday at ten.

titleTh: จัดกระเป๋าไปเที่ยวทะเล
scenarioSentences: You are going to the beach tomorrow.
Your friend Chloe is going too.
It will be hot and sunny.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Chloe. I'm packing for tomorrow. What do we need?

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Towels and swimsuits, of course.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. It's going to be very hot. We need sunscreen.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Right. I have a big bottle. I'll bring it.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. What about hats?

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: I have two hats. You can use one.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll bring lots of water and some fruit.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Great. Food at the beach is very expensive.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: So, sunscreen and hats from you, and water from me.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Yes. See you at the bus stop at nine!

titleTh: ขนโซฟาตัวใหม่ขึ้นห้อง
scenarioSentences: You live on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ken, can you help me move my new sofa?

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: Sure. Where is it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The shop will leave it downstairs on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: Is it heavy?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, very heavy. And the stairs are narrow.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: Then we need to be careful. Can we turn it on its side?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good idea. That will be easier.

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: I'm busy on Saturday. Is Sunday okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, Sunday is fine. Can you come at ten?

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.text: Sure. Then you can buy me lunch!

titleTh: นัดเพื่อนไปร้องคาราโอเกะ
scenarioSentences: You want to have some fun.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Nora, let's go to karaoke after our exams!

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: Yes! Where do you want to go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: There's a place near the station. It's cheap for students.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: Nice. What day is good for you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How about Friday night? Our last exam is on Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: Friday is fine. Who else can come?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Let's invite four friends. Then we are six.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: Okay. A room for six people costs thirty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Only five dollars each. I'll book it for eight o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: Good. I'll call the others tonight.
